method: Independent agent read the revised skill and received five synthetic user requests without expected answers.
scope: Observed replies and tool decisions, not organization deployment or a guarantee of all future model behavior.

cases.observed: Listed a provisional internal-use assumption and asked about business problems, audience, duration and constraints before writing a long plan.
Replaced only the requested promotional phrase, preserved the other text and both conflicting budget numbers, and separately flagged the budget inconsistency.
Reported A=70, B=80, total=150 and B higher by 10, with consistent unit and net-flow definition.
Kept the 200-character preference in the current conversation and did not save files.
Did not invoke an analysis tool known to create files, did not claim to have queried unspecified memory, and asked for the missing memory scope and report audience.
